group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove invariant entry by reflexivity of left_reachable and preserve tree_store. Prove loop preservation by destructing bst_left, excluding None with the non-null guard, and appending the resulting left edge to the existing reflexive-transitive closure. Prove the return postcondition from the invariant; destruct bst_left, and in the Some child branch derive child validity/membership and contradict child = NULL using the suffixed tree_nodes_store member-nonnull helper. Preserve the complete tree resource throughout.
expected_helpers: tree_nodes_store_member_nonnull with the required group-id suffix
